scope: Independent operation-rounded Float32 world sweep sampling plus Gaussian/DOF support; CPU only, not proof of legacy screen-streak equality

cases.name: Independent Float32 transforms of corners and continuous swept source samples remain outside Gaussian/DOF support
A physical sweep crossing the viewport is retained even when its centre is far outside
Near-plane-crossing but wholly top-side physical sweeps are excluded
DOF can retain a close offscreen source whose blur reaches the viewport
Vector raster exposure and scalar zero-duration shutter use the correct world domain
Public Float32 attributes and reversed shutter direction keep equivalent swept domains
Smoke, threshold uncertainty and nonfinite input retain their existing upload
Viewport side-plane and ordinary on-axis support boundaries are retained
